Yang Xiu Hui’s Backstage Selfie

Yang Xiu Hui, a veteran Taiwanese actress, shared a close-up selfie from her dressing room. She wears a pink tweed jacket with gold chain detailing and subtle, elegant makeup. Behind her, illuminated vanity mirrors and studio chairs hint at a television studio environment.

This photo accompanies a news report in which Yang Xiu Hui revealed on social media that she was upset after a variety show host called her “cheap.” She expressed lingering hurt days after the recording and announced she would no longer participate in that program.

source.title: 「太相信自己人才會被坑！」36坪老屋裝潢喊價650萬⋯楊繡惠氣炸：被當「盤子」很不舒服 - 今周刊
source.description:
楊繡惠活動現場亮相

楊繡惠身穿黑色蕾絲禮服，優雅地站在印有《大時代》與TIME雜誌封面的背景牆前，面帶自信微笑。她的造型以透視蕾絲與垂墜耳環為亮點，展現成熟魅力。

這位直率的藝人近期在社群平台上分享了為36坪樓中樓舊屋裝潢時，認識的設計師開出650萬元天價報價，讓她感嘆「太相信自己人就會被坑」。她表示若裝潢費如此高昂，寧可購買新房，並自嘲過去因信任而匯款的經歷，引發網友熱議。此外，她也因母親店門口的盆栽被偷，調閱監視器後準備報警，並在直播中痛斥竊賊，表達對此事的憤怒與無奈。

source.description:
Yang Xiu-hui’s Television Appearance

Yang Xiu-hui appears on a brightly lit set, wearing a silver dress with layered necklaces and statement earrings. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo, and she smiles confidently against a red backdrop adorned with star patterns. 

The metadata reveals that Yang Xiu-hui recently made headlines by declaring “I want to tell you I am Taiwanese” and refusing to earn Chinese yuan. Her statement garnered significant online support, with nearly twenty thousand likes and over a thousand comments praising her authenticity and defense of Taiwan’s sovereignty.
